proven_findings.evidence: The dispatcher accepts five caller-cleaned arguments and resolves arguments 2 and 3 through 0x004320D9 before any effect processing.
A null definition, caster session record, or target session record returns zero.
0x00420CB2 can intercept the action; when the global output gate is enabled the dispatcher clears target field +0xBA and invokes 0x0044C85F before returning zero.
Caster field +0xB0 must be positive and fear/state bit 0x80 at +0x7C8 must be clear; otherwise output is emitted and the action returns zero.
Restriction/status check 0x4F through 0x0043D570 rejects execution and emits two diagnostic fragments before flushing output.
The caster class record at +0x92 is resolved; class type 5 with invocation-mode argument zero applies restriction/status check 0x9F and rejects on success.
Caster location fields +0xC8 and +0xC4 are passed to 0x0043202C; missing room context returns zero.
Two shared globals are zeroed, transient bits 0x0404 are cleared on caster and eligible target records, and caster byte +0x5F6 is reset before execution.
Definition target-kind values 0, 1, or 2 reject caster-equals-target with a dedicated diagnostic.
A configuration byte, room flags, online-session state, target kind, and helper 0x0043DB62 jointly gate the action before effect processing.

classification.proven: character/creature target spell dispatcher entry contract and preflight state gates
